ore_refinery_evidence.scope: read-only official offsets/restricted regions/three-faction geometry and separate project reservation; no dock-bone coordinates inferred

official_placement.scope: official building placement/collision and explicit script creation exits; public reserves remain separate; unresolved decorations are uncovered rather than qualified
official_placement.strict_scope: all applicable native buildings and explicit building creation actions

map_xml_assets.scope: inline assets and non-SDK includes in map.xml; DATA/ART resource includes retain the base SDK source assumption

package_overrides.scope: package-specific definitions are bound to the report; SDK geometry is not claimed exact for unresolved overrides

scope: automatic structural/placement checks plus diagnostic unit-state routes; independent delivery checks remain separate

binding.collision_model: conservative square around official collision bounding circle

limitations: Static geometry only; no dynamic collision, turning simulation, engine pathfinder or AI decision prediction.
Each locomotor and condition is analysed separately. No state transition or ability activation is inferred.
Factory exits are capability probes for actual native factories and explicitly typed scripted creation branches; production roster and automatic state changes are not inferred.
Terrain steps use the project spatial policy, not an inferred engine SlopeLimitIndex table.
Crushable obstacles remain solid. AIR, CLIFF and other special locomotor surfaces are not modelled.
Resource routes end in a bounded approach region; capture, harvesting and weapon permissions are not inferred.
